visual.general_description: AP spine L1-L4 bone mineral density versus age chart with Normal, Osteopenia and Osteoporosis zones, a GE T-score axis and one unlabeled plotted marker.
visual.detailed_description: Rectangular color-zone chart with a dark-green "Normal" zone at the top, a yellow "Osteopenia" zone in the middle and a red "Osteoporosis" zone at the bottom; the zone names are printed in the left of each zone. Title text "AP Spine : L1-L4" at the top centre, "BMD (g/cm²)" above the left axis and "GE T-score" above the right axis. Left axis printed ticks (comma decimal separators): 1,397; 1,273; 1,149; 1,025; 0,901; 0,777; 0,653; 0,529. Right T-score axis ticks: 2, 1, 0, -1, -2, -3, -4, -5. X axis "Age (years)" with labeled ticks 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100. The green/yellow boundary lies at BMD 1,025 (T-score -1) and the yellow/red boundary lies near T-score -2.5 (about BMD 0,84, between the 0,901 and 0,777 ticks; the exact printed boundary value is not labeled). Three parallel black sloping lines run horizontally from about age 20 to about age 45 and then slope downward to the right edge at age 100; lighter-shaded bands lie between them (lighter green in the upper-left, lighter red/pink in the lower-right). The lines carry no labels or legend. One small unlabeled black rectangle with a pale outline sits inside the red zone; it spans roughly age 66-69 (centre about 67-68) and its vertical centre lies at about T-score -3.5 on the right axis (about BMD 0,71 on the left axis), by visual estimate against the axes; no legend, label or arrow explains it. No patient name, ID, date, device text or face is present.

visual.general_description: Grayscale DEXA-style lumbar spine image labeled L2, L3 and L4 with yellow outlines and purple plus-sign markers.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale, low-resolution and blurry portrait image of a spine radiograph-like DEXA display; a central vertical column of vertebral levels is darker than the lighter lateral background. Three bold black text labels at the left margin read L2, L3 and L4 from top to bottom. No L1 label is visible; the top edge of the image is cropped through an upper vertebral region. Irregular, hand-drawn-looking yellow outlines enclose rounded or rectangular regions along the central column (several per level, outlines overlap the L3-L4 region) and extend to the bottom edge. Three small purple/magenta plus signs sit inside the outlines: one between the L3 and L4 labels (right of centre), one level with the L4 label (centre) and one below the L4 label (left of centre). A darker horizontal gray band crosses the lower edge of the image below the outlined region. No axes, scale bar, numeric BMD/T-score table, color legend, name, ID, date or device text is visible. No face or genital/sensitive anatomy is visible; no burned-in identifiers or timestamps are visible.
